body: DESIGN CONSENSUS, WITH GOVERNANCE AND EVIDENCE GATES EXPLICITLY OPEN. Adopt docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md at 669 lines and SHA-256 b12f79ceb61e020cd02c43c631ed015a9034d9c3b9c597da726337425a21e748 as the current D1-D10 architecture consensus. Exact-hash acceptance is recorded from codex-storymodel-collab, codex-storymodel-new-engineer, and codex-storyatlas-root; adversarial time/identity, status/boundary, leakage, cache/permutation, admission, and playback findings are incorporated. The architecture is one shared narrative model over retained source evidence and feature artifacts, with only joined semantic proposals and critic findings entering deterministic resolution. This decision does not close P1, B0/Q5, or admit an F2 pair, source asset, dependency, model, weight, provider, terms, or API migration. Movie implementation remains blocked until the admitted real-transcript research gate and exact admission gate both close. ADR authority must still reconcile ADR 0007 board ratification with its Proposed file header. A later valid counterexample should reopen the smallest affected decision, not erase this record.
